text:
Eastern Illinois women's soccer to face Purdue in third match of season Sunday
Eastern Illinois University will play its third women's soccer match of the season against Purdue University on Sunday, Aug. 23 at Folk Field in West Lafayette, Indiana.
Both teams enter the game with a 1-0-1 record. Eastern Illinois began its season with a 2-0 win over Valparaiso, marking its first opening win since 2017, and followed up with a scoreless draw against UIC. Purdue also holds a win and a draw and is scheduled to host Chicago State before facing Eastern Illinois.
Eastern Illinois had two players receive Ohio Valley Conference honors following week one. Casey Kittridge was named OVC Defender of the Week after playing all 90 minutes against Valparaiso and leading field player minutes in the draw with UIC. Ella Kratochvil earned OVC Goalkeeper of the Week for making six saves in each match; it was her fourth time receiving this honor during her career at EIU.
Kratochvil added two shutouts to her career total during opening week, moving into a tie for third on EIU's all-time shutouts list with 16. Amelia Mundo scored her first goal for EIU in the win over Valparaiso, providing an insurance goal late in the match. Last season, Mundo appeared in 14 matches after transferring from Missouri S&T.
The Panthers return three All-Ohio Valley Conference first team selections from last year: Kratochvil (goalkeeper), Alex Tetteh (forward), and Colleen Bauer (defender). Camylle Graves was named to the All-OVC Newcomer team for 2025. In addition to these returning players, Abby Reinl and Brooklynn Greene were listed as OVC Players to Watch for this season.
Head coach Dirk Bennett enters his fourth year leading Eastern Illinois' women's soccer program, having previously served as assistant coach since July 2019. Under Bennett's leadership, EIU posted an eight-win season last year—the most since 2007—and finished .500 or better for the first time since 2006.
